quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
quizzes.backend_description: The image shows a number line from -4 to 1 with three points labeled a, b, and c marked with blue dots. Point a is at approximately -2.83, point b is at approximately -1.73, and point c is at approximately -0.79.
solution: Approximate $$-\sqrt{8}$$: What number multiplied by itself gives me 8? $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$2 \times 2 = 4$$ (too small) $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$3 \times 3 = 9$$ (too big) $$\\[0.5em]$$ • So $$\sqrt{8}$$ is between 2 and 3, meaning $$-\sqrt{8}$$ is between −3 and −2.

Approximate $$-\sqrt{3}$$: What number multiplied by itself gives me 3? $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$1 \times 1 = 1$$ (too small) $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$2 \times 2 = 4$$ (too big) $$\\[0.5em]$$ • So $$\sqrt{3}$$ is between 1 and 2, meaning $$-\sqrt{3}$$ is between −2 and −1.
Approximate $$-\frac{\pi}{4}$$: We know $$\pi \approx 3.14$$, so $$\frac{\pi}{4} \approx 3.14 \div 4 \approx 0.785$$. That means $$-\frac{\pi}{4} \approx -0.785$$, which is between −1 and 0.

Now match to the number line: $$\\[0.5em]$$ • a is between −3 and −2 → matches $$-\sqrt{8}$$ $$\\[0.5em]$$ • b is between −2 and −1 → matches $$-\sqrt{3}$$ $$\\[0.5em]$$ • c is between −1 and 0 → matches $$-\frac{\pi}{4}$$ $$\\[0.5em]$$ The answer is D.
